verdict.rationale: Devin is offered as a cloud-hosted SaaS agent (with a local CLI/terminal front-end that hands off to 'cloud Devin'); there is no evidence of a self-hostable agent runtime deployable in your own containers/VMs, and docs explicitly describe delegating heavier work to Cognition's cloud infrastructure. Missing for 10: any documentation of self-hosted/on-prem deployment, container images, or VM installation instructions for the core agent infrastructure.
